name: Isolated profile browser cores
evidence: Distinct Chromium/Gecko profile directories; Chrome/Firefox external engines; optional per-engine SHA-256 pinning for installed official Chrome/Edge/Firefox binaries with checksum validation at each launch
gaps: No maintained native Chromium/Firefox fork or reliable per-profile OS/kernel emulation
acceptance: Verified engine-level isolation on actual Windows Chrome, Edge and Firefox

name: Profile management and mass operations
evidence: Group, tag, search, multi-start URLs, quick create, CSV import/update, recycle bin
gaps: No selective revocable profile sharing, Cookie import, account linkage or full workbook parity
acceptance: Functional bulk CRUD and crash/rollback tests with real browser state

name: Native fingerprint controls
evidence: Native defaults, configuration diagnostics and experimental extension-based controls
gaps: No source-level browser implementation of timezone, WebRTC, GPU/Canvas/WebGPU, device identity, OS feature consistency or TLS controls
acceptance: Cross-context browser-engine fingerprint consistency, device tests and native-source review

name: Proxy Center
evidence: HTTP/SOCKS5 auth gateway, OS-encrypted passwords, verify and bulk assign
gaps: Missing SSH/HTTPS variants, rotation scheduler, location/ASN targeting, vendor integration
acceptance: End-to-end real proxy network tests with failure/rotation conditions

name: Extension Center
evidence: Local trusted unpacked MV3 catalog, assign, remove
gaps: Chrome/Edge command line activation not verified; no ZIP, Web Store, cloud distribution or Firefox add-ons
acceptance: Packaged Windows activation tests with real Chrome/Edge versions

name: Multiwindow Synchronizer
evidence: Win32 foreground, grid, cascade and shared startup URLs; explicit new-tab navigation via localhost Chrome DevTools on running profiles
gaps: No master/slave click/input/scroll/tab synchronization, multi-monitor layout or keyboard shortcuts
acceptance: Real desktop synchronized interactions tested with explicit user authorization

name: RPA Plus and workflow marketplace
evidence: Approval-gated Studio, conditional/repeat steps, recording, local schedules, flow diagram; manual multi-profile sequential runner with per-profile approvals, stop/continue error handling and durable local audit
gaps: No mature drag-drop editor, cross-profile execution, template marketplace or multi-user permissioning
acceptance: Editor, scheduler and audit end-to-end tests and independent human approvals

name: AI Agent
evidence: OS-encrypted OpenRouter Advisor, aggregate opt-in sharing and manual workflow drafts
gaps: No bounded multi-step autonomous agent, tool approvals, reliable browser interaction, cost ledger or recovery checkpoints
acceptance: Audited tool policies, explicit approvals, budget guard and real test workflows

name: Local API and CLI
evidence: Loopback authenticated Local API and source Node CLI
gaps: Not complete AdsPower API parity; no standalone Windows CLI; MCP intentionally not exposed
acceptance: Documented versioned API contract, authorization and e2e compatibility tests

name: Team roles, permissions and activity logging
evidence: Tenant- and group-scoped Team policy, self-hosted HTTPS service with administrator-provisioned bearer token identities, single-use invite/redeem, membership revocation/audit and desktop member UI; Windows HTTP e2e tests
gaps: No hosted public Team deployment, external identity provider/passkeys/MFA, automated credential onboarding, per-group Team UI administration, high availability or independent security review
acceptance: Independent account RBAC and tenant isolation penetration tests

name: Secure multi-device cloud sync
evidence: AES-256-GCM ciphertext-only self-hosted HTTPS sync service, manual Electron push/preview/import of strictly whitelisted profile metadata, local revision CAS and tests, single-instance durable file persistence
gaps: No public deployed service, database-backed multi-replica transactions, automatic/offline incremental sync, device/key lifecycle, conflict merge UI, production two-device proof or browser session sharing
acceptance: Encrypted transport/rest, cross-device conflict tests, recovery and secure sharing

name: Team and device safety settings
evidence: Local engine settings, health checks, OS vault, startup safeguards
gaps: No per-role IP allowlist, enterprise 2FA, full bandwidth/media or device settings
acceptance: Windows-level settings verification and enterprise policy tests

name: Cache snapshots and recovery
evidence: Explicit preview and cache-only cleanup for stopped profiles; AES-256-GCM PBKDF2 passphrase-protected local session snapshots with per-profile restore and live-session lock; encrypted external .lhmsnap file import/export restricted to original profile ID and engine; recover original profile identity and browser session from offline backup after local reinstall
gaps: No encrypted browser-session snapshot restore, cloud caches, granular storage-class deletion
acceptance: Session recovery and data-integrity checks after crash

name: Billing, plans and integrated providers
evidence: Ed25519 public-key offline license validation, installation ID, monthly issuer, expiry and activation UI; private issuer key not shipped; v5.1 main-process license gate for profile creation, RPA, Local API and browser startup plus bounded 30-day trial; signed online verification receipts, vendor-hosted revocation list and limited 72-hour offline grace (optional HTTPS authority); v5.4 local customer/license ledger, one-time issue/renew, expiring-soon reporting, admin-only revocation and audit history; private static HTML dashboard for customers, license statuses and renewals (local-only, no operator web server)
gaps: No hosted multi-user admin portal, online payment/checkout and refunds, issuer key rotation or actual deployed license authority; local ledger is not a production SaaS database
acceptance: Payment compliance, entitlement, chargeback and accounting verification

name: Cloud Phone integration
gaps: No third-party cloud-phone support or device lifecycle integration
acceptance: Provider contract tests and permissioned device sessions
